494: Simulating the transmission of environmental readings (temperature and humidity) from a device to a business workstation through an MQTT broker, keeping the data confidential even from the broker itself.

499: Three Ubuntu virtual machines on one local network: a sender (device), a receiver (business workstation) and a Mosquitto broker. An AES key is derived from a shared identifier using PBKDF2, and the MQTT topic is derived using SHA-256. The sender encrypts and publishes a JSON message; the receiver subscribes to the same topic, decrypts it and displays it. The broker handles ciphertext only. Its address is stored in an external configuration file.
